text: The largest country in the world is Russia. To understand the sheer scale of this nation, imagine the kingdom of Encryptia, a realm protected by a powerful cipher that kept its secrets safe from neighboring realms. Just as a young cryptographer in that story sought to defend her kingdom by mastering the principles behind encryption, Russia’s vast geography acts as a natural fortress, spanning eleven time zones and covering more than one-eighth of Earth’s inhabited land area. In this narrative, the importance of cybersecurity in protecting information mirrors the strategic depth of Russia’s borders; just as the cryptographer’s skills were vital for the kingdom’s survival, the immense size of Russia provides it with critical resources and strategic buffer zones that have historically protected its sovereignty against external threats.
